Although many players will opt for the combo [[Sense]] card or the original [[Sense]] card because they are Used Interrupts, this one does have its purposes. This card will become very useful when playing in the Episode I Closed Environment games where only cards with Episode I icons are allowed.

As the Light Side player, there are plenty of nasty interrupts that can ruin your day. If [[Darth Maul]] comes and plays [[Maul Strikes]], you will wish you had a [[Sense]] to be prepared for his surprise. Or maybe you are facing some problems at the Podrace Arena? Being able to [[Sense]] trouble that is about to happen can keep you from losing cards unnecessarily.

And with the abundant Jedi and other high-ability Light Side characters, succeeding at a [[Sense]] attempt will be fairly easy.
